command.dsh: Enable DSH Bridge and Copy Descriptor Path
setting.language: Display language for AgentCode Live views and messages. Reload the window to apply. VS Code command names and setting labels follow the VS Code display language.
setting.enabled: Observe file changes in trusted local workspaces.
setting.follow: Follow file changes in a background editor or a read-only Cinematic preview.
setting.mode: Instant uses disk snapshots. Cinematic animates a known snapshot as a presentation effect.
setting.speed: Target rate for revealing changed lines in live viewing, replay and Cinematic previews.
setting.history: Persist recorded source snapshots and Agent activity in local VS Code storage.
setting.historyLimit: Maximum historical snapshot data per workspace, in MiB.
setting.fileLimit: Maximum size of an observed UTF-8 file, in KiB.
setting.ignore: Additional gitignore-style paths to exclude, relative to each workspace root.
setting.addedColor: Background for added lines, as a CSS color such as #2ea04355. Empty uses the VS Code theme.
setting.codexExecutable: Path to the Codex executable, or codex on PATH.
